generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Contractors should have valid Civil Contractor registration in BWSSB or KPWD/KUWSDB, etc
Form of tender is mandatory to upload in KPPP portal
Assessed available tender capacity (AxNx5 - B) should be greater than amount put to tender

The Tenderer should have in the last 5 years period achieved in at least one financial years an average annual financial turnover of rupees not less than the estimated cost i.e., Rs.40.95 lakhs. (Profit & Loss Account, Balance sheet certified/Audited by Charted Accountant)
The Tenderer should have satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor for at least any one construction work such as W/S work to an extent of 25% of the work i.e10.24 lakhs

CAT-SC) Caste certificate and domicile certificate is mandatory to be uploaded in www.kppp.karnataka.gov.in portal as per G.O No. FD 876 Exp-12/2017 Dt:1.10.2017. failing which tender will be technically non responsive

If in two attempts of tender bidding process, Bidders belonging to CAT-SC) participant is not qualified under this rule, then these works shall be tendered as open category wherein all eligible bidders of General or Scheduled castes or Schedules tribes category can participate.
If contractor is the firm, then all the partners or members of the firm shall belong to the CAT-SC)as the case may be
The contractor belonging to the CAT-SC) shall be domicile of the state of Karnataka for more than 10 Years

Security deposit for an amount equaling to 5% of the contract price payable shall be deducted in every running bill. However in case of first and final bill the entire security deposit will be deducted from the final Bill
